user.title: Kostal Piko
user.description: Connect to the web interface of your Kostal Piko inverter. In the next step you choose the sensors.

data_description.name: Used for the device and the entity IDs, e.g. kostal_piko.
data_description.host: Address of the inverter, e.g. http://192.168.1.50
data_description.username: Login of the inverter's web interface (usually pvserver).

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Choose the sensors to create. The preselection contains everything this inverter provides, the own-consumption (BA) sensors only if the inverter reports values for them. You can change the selection later via Configure.

reconfigure.title: Kostal Piko
reconfigure.description: Change the address or login of the inverter. Sensors and history are kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Kostal Piko login
reauth_confirm.description: The inverter at {host} rejected the login. Enter the current username and password.

plant.title: Plant data
plant.description: Optional. Enter the installed power of each string that is in use; leave unused strings empty. The maximum output power is the throttled AC power your inverter may feed in. The values are used for the utilization and specific yield sensors and for cards. Both can be changed later via Configure.

data_description.string1_power_wp: Module power of string 1 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.string2_power_wp: Module power of string 2 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.string3_power_wp: Module power of string 3 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.max_output_power: Maximum AC power in W, e.g. 7000 for a throttled 10 kW inverter. Empty means not set.

error.could_not_connect: Could not connect to the inverter. Check the host, username and password.
error.unsupported_device: This inverter is not supported: its web pages have an unknown structure. Open an issue at {issues_url} and attach the pages index.fhtml and Solar2.fhtml (remove the serial number first).

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different inverter (serial number does not match).

init.title: Kostal Piko
init.description: Choose the sensors that are created and how often the inverter is read. The inverter needs about 1 s per page, so values below 10 s make no sense.

data_description.string1_power_wp: Module power of string 1 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.string2_power_wp: Module power of string 2 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.string3_power_wp: Module power of string 3 in Wp. Empty means the string is unused.
data_description.max_output_power: Maximum AC power in W, e.g. 7000 for a throttled 10 kW inverter. Empty means not set.
